params.message:
Gentells links come with what was read from the page

source_links and source_keep gave a page's Gentells link and nothing of the page. To write
with the figures, an assistant then opened the publisher's page itself, and the Claude app
shows the address of every page it opens beside the text: a paragraph meant to cite
gentells.com came back with chips to vdab.be and Eurostat.

Each link now comes with what Gentells read when the page was kept: its title, publisher,
date and text, the text cut to a share of the answer (4,000 characters a page, less when
many are named). A note tells the assistant to write from it and not to open the page. A
page that could not be read says so and brings no text. No signal id and nothing of who
kept it goes out.

Portal: Een assistent die met Gentells-bronnen schrijft, krijgt de tekst van de pagina mee, zodat er alleen Gentells-links in de tekst staan.
